description: The v12 AHCIP-focused auditor system prompt (pivoted Zorva to Canada-first / Alberta Health). The auditor's source-of-truth copy at src/ai_billing_audit/auditor_prompt.txt is overwritten at build time by the Dockerfile COPY of this file; this manifest pins the deployed canonical text. If the file content changes, regenerate the manifest content_sha256 + byte_size (do not edit the hashes by hand). Swarm-batch3 (2026-07-04): re-pinned after B-Engine-2 fix that replaced the editable-install fallback with the canonical v12 copy.

loaders.default: ai_billing_audit.auditor.load_prompt() with no path argument resolves to the Dockerfile-installed copy under src/ at import time via importlib.resources.
